reference_basis.attribution_rule: Distinguish principles supported by the inspected public chapter, general knowledge of the book, and our own project-specific application. Do not invent quotations, page numbers or claims of having read the complete supplied edition.

project_application: Control complexity: identify the shared cause of adjacent failures and simplify responsibility boundaries; an additional abstraction must reduce actual duplicated knowledge or coupling.
Information hiding and coherent interfaces: keep source-format details behind trusted source access; consumers should use a stable material contract rather than reverse-parse each producer's JSON.
Consistent contracts: prefer one typed business definition and installed framework schema/validation support; inspect the final model-facing schema and downstream consumers for divergence.
Evidence-led debugging: trace symptoms through production source and execution evidence, test competing hypotheses, and distinguish confirmed mechanisms from unknown external causes.

Safe refactoring and incremental integration: preserve valid history, provenance and unknown outcomes, verify the affected path with real inputs and outputs, and continue toward the full Word/XLSX report outcome.
Independent review: Neo checks source, design tradeoffs, execution traces and actual artifacts; passing local tests alone cannot establish end-to-end completion.

roles.Codex: Investigate, choose and explain design tradeoffs, implement, and supply source/test/trace/artifact evidence.
roles.Neo: Challenge root-cause and design reasoning using source code and relevant references, propose improvements, and inspect actual results.

current_scope: Apply to the current contract/material/effect-state architectural convergence and subsequent authorized development. This reference requirement does not authorize a new runtime policy, book-derived mandatory agent sequence, new paid run, unknown-result replay or publication. Existing project authorizations and full-chain objective remain.
